en.headline: Flags to fly at half-staff Tuesday for late former premier Zhu Rongji
en.dek: The Hong Kong government will lower national and regional flags at Central Government Offices, Government House, boundary control points and the airport on 18 August as a token of mourning.
body: The Hong Kong Special Administrative Region Government announced that the national flag and the regional flag displayed at the Central Government Offices in Tamar, Government House, all boundary control and check points, and Hong Kong International Airport will be flown at half-staff on Tuesday 18 August.

The arrangement follows notification from the Central People's Government and is a token of mourning for the late Mr Zhu Rongji, former Premier of the State Council. Zhu died in Beijing on 12 August at the age of 97; his remains are to be cremated in Beijing on Tuesday.
Similar half-staff measures will apply at designated sites across the Mainland, in Macao and at Chinese embassies and consulates overseas, according to official statements.

zh.headline: 悼念前總理朱鎔基 下周二港府指定場所下半旗
zh.dek: 按中央人民政府通知，港府將於8月18日在添馬政府總部、禮賓府、各口岸及機場將國旗及區旗下半旗致哀。
body: 香港特別行政區政府公布，按中央人民政府通知，8月18日（星期二）在添馬政府總部、禮賓府、香港特別行政區所有邊境管制站及檢查站，以及香港國際機場懸掛的國旗及區旗將下半旗，以示對前國務院總理朱鎔基先生的哀悼。
朱鎔基於8月12日在北京逝世，享年97歲；其遺體將於星期二在北京火化。
根據官方安排，內地指定場所、澳門以及中國駐外使領館亦會採取相若下半旗措施。
